content.text: I would like to find a job, do I first need to obtain a work permit?

Yes, you need a specific permit to work. You cannot apply for a work permit yourself; your employer must apply for a TWV (Employment Permit) from the Employee Insurance Agency (UWV). <source>1</source>[PARAGRAPH_BREAK]This permit is free of charge for the employer. You may only begin working after the UWV has approved the application and issued the permit.<source>1</source>[PARAGRAPH_BREAK]<options><option>TWV application process</option><option>Employer responsibilities</option><option>UWV contact details</options></options>

The car is parked close to the vegetation, which might be a safety concern if the car moves unexpectedly. The scene appears to take place in a public space, but the specific type of public space (e.g., residential, commercial) is not clear from the image. Overall, there are accessibility and safety concerns present in this image.
